run_cs_gan_training: run the cs_gan training script on cifar or mnist with configurable batch size and learning rates
review_main_training_loop: review the main function training loop that alternates discriminator and generator update ops
build_gan_model: build a cs_gan GAN model with latent optimization steps and configurable z projection method

export_generated_samples: export generated samples and real data using FileExporter during training iterations
